name: evenings_only_select
label: Are you able to work overtime?
spec_quote: Option lists with an "evenings only" style choice ("Just evenings", "Evenings only", "Only evenings", "Weeknights only") → that option.

name: evenings_only_radio
label: Are you available for overtime?
spec_quote: Option lists with an "evenings only" style choice ("Just evenings", "Evenings only", "Only evenings", "Weeknights only") → that option.

name: only_evenings_option
label: Overtime availability
spec_quote: Option lists with an "evenings only" style choice … → that option.

name: weeknights_only_option
label: When can you work overtime?
spec_quote: Option lists with an "evenings only" style choice ("…", "Weeknights only") → that option.

name: yes_no_select_overtime
label: Are you willing to work overtime?
spec_quote: Yes / No only → "Yes".

name: yes_no_radio_overtime
label: Can you work overtime?
spec_quote: Yes / No only → "Yes".

name: free_text_overtime
label: What overtime are you available for?
spec_quote: Free text → "Evenings only".

name: free_text_overtime_alt
label: Please describe your availability for overtime.
spec_quote: Free text → "Evenings only".

name: travel_question
label: Are you willing to travel?
spec_quote: Questions that do not ask about overtime (e.g. "Are you willing to travel?" …) → "NOT_OVERTIME".

name: hours_per_week_text
label: How many hours per week can you work?
spec_quote: Questions that do not ask about overtime (… "How many hours per week can you work?") → "NOT_OVERTIME".

name: evening_only_beats_combined
label: What overtime can you work?
spec_quote: Options that only combine evenings with weekends ("Yes, evenings and/or weekends"), weekends only, or "No" are never picked when an evenings-only option exists.

name: evening_only_beats_combined_order
label: Overtime availability
spec_quote: Options that only combine evenings with weekends … are never picked when an evenings-only option exists.

name: weekends_only_never_picked
label: Select your overtime availability
spec_quote: Options that only combine evenings with weekends …, weekends only, or "No" are never picked when an evenings-only option exists.

name: combined_no_evenings_option
label: What overtime are you available for?
why: The spec only says these options are 'never picked when an evenings-only option exists'; it does not state what to answer when no evenings-only option is present, so the required outcome is undefined.
spec_quote: Options that only combine evenings with weekends ("Yes, evenings and/or weekends"), weekends only, or "No" are never picked when an evenings-only option exists.

name: weekends_only_no_evenings_option
label: Overtime availability
why: Applicant never works weekends and cannot answer 'No' to overtime either, but the spec only forbids picking these 'when an evenings-only option exists'; with no evenings-only option the required answer is unspecified.
spec_quote: Options that only combine evenings with weekends …, weekends only, or "No" are never picked when an evenings-only option exists.

name: weekends_yes_no_question
label: Are you available to work weekends?
why: The literal rule 'Yes / No only → "Yes"' conflicts with the confirmed answer 'never weekends'; the spec does not carve out weekend-specific Yes/No questions.
spec_quote: Yes / No only → "Yes".

name: work_authorization_yes_no
label: Are you legally authorized to work in this country?
spec_quote: Questions that do not ask about overtime … → "NOT_OVERTIME".

name: evening_shifts_not_overtime
label: Are you available to work evening shifts?
why: This asks about shift availability, not overtime, so the literal reading gives NOT_OVERTIME, but the spec's only non-overtime examples are travel and hours-per-week, so an implementer might treat any evening-related question as an overtime question.
spec_quote: Questions that do not ask about overtime (e.g. "Are you willing to travel?", "How many hours per week can you work?") → "NOT_OVERTIME".

name: salary_text_not_overtime
label: What is your desired hourly rate?
spec_quote: Questions that do not ask about overtime … → "NOT_OVERTIME".

name: any_time_including_weekends_option
label: What is your overtime availability?
spec_quote: Options that only combine evenings with weekends …, weekends only, or "No" are never picked when an evenings-only option exists.
